description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Insert class, which compiles the {insert} tag in Smarty templates. It handles parsing attributes, managing caching, including scripts, and generating PHP code for insertions, contributing to Smarty's template compilation process.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Insert
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {insert} tag in Smarty templates, enabling dynamic inclusion of scripts or functions within templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the Smarty {insert} tag, handling attributes, script inclusion, and function invocation based on template attributes.
